title: Autonomous SEO engineer - by SEOAgent | Grok Bot Templates | Somi
description: Installs the SEOAgent skill and CLI in your website GitHub repo, then runs a weekday loop as the SEO harness for your coding agent: apply worthwhile recommendations in the repo, or reject them with a specific reason. Local skill work is free; daily keyword, Search Console, backlink, and competitor suggestions need Pro. It will not invent traffic, rankings, or testimonials, will not write thin keyword pages, will not add a CMS if you don't already have one, and will not merge or deploy without approval.
